verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions uploading or importing a CSV or spreadsheet file as a data source. The only integration evidence is a generic marketing line about "native connectors, open APIs, and scheduled imports", which names no file format or manual upload path. Agent Connectors to Google Drive give the AI agents business context; they are not a data-loading capability for the planning model, so that is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can load a CSV or spreadsheet as a first-class data source when no connector exists
